scheduled_budgets: Each integer 0 to 24 additional fourth-seat hours per day
rosters: Zero, a continuous shift, or two nonoverlapping integer-start blocks with lengths differing by at most one hour. In the two-block case enumerate both orders and every positive gap, ending inside the relative 24h day. Deduplicate adjacent blocks as continuous. Extended current case finish is paid. Original 3 permanent seats and A20 unchanged.
training: Relative day 1 curve; 16 replications, root 34102641, 14+14 days plus ongoing arrivals. Exhaust the 3271 feasible schedules. Reuse 190 archived six-hour training rows from the identical prior first-day experiment.
selection: Separately per budget, if any training roster has a pointwise 95% upper L bound at most 5%, minimise H, then L; otherwise minimise (H+L)/2, then H, then L. Finally choose lexicographically earliest canonical list of windows. Do not retune to day 2.
screen: Lock all 25 before loading the second curve for the new budget tests. On day 2, run all under A20 and same-roster FCFS with 80 independent paired replications (root 34102642). Original low-risk gate: pointwise two-sided 95% upper L bound <=5%. Also show same-roster reduction in H vs FCFS, original target >=2pp by the pointwise lower bound. Joint column requires both original daily gates. Individual fixed-hour cohorts are not part of the daily target here.
multiplicity: For scanning 25 budgets, also report Bonferroni familywise 95% two-sided intervals on L (df 79; critical 3.196628436099664, two-sided local alpha .05/25). They quantify simulated draws from this single fixed curve. Report these separately from the original pointwise test. The threshold is among 25 independently trained rosters, not among every conceivable roster.
fresh_confirmation: On relative day 2, use new root 34102643, 80 paired replications, to independently confirm the first budget passing the original L screen, its predecessor, and the analogous earliest joint and multiplicity-adjusted L-pass budgets plus predecessors if different. Include the 24-hour endpoint if no budget passes one of the screen rules. Confirmatory intervals are pointwise and reported even if they reverse the screening decision; do not adapt further.
forecast_use: Transaction hour shapes separately derived from 144786 and 140021 relative-day rows respectively, each rescaled to 540 expected synthetic alerts/day. The second shape was used in the previously reported six-hour study; it is excluded from all new schedule searches. No actual local clock or bank desk timing is supplied.
